envelopes.consumedFor: staleness notice; 360-minute threshold; older envelopes never repaint

dataFields.fallback: EMPTY panel: waiting for branch packets + Refresh/Inspect CTAs

dataFields.type: array<{missionId, title, owner, gate, proofRequired, dispatchTarget, status}>
dataFields.fallback: MissionCard in blocked state: 'Mission queue missing', dispatchTarget 'inspect'
mission state derives from mission.status with 'pending' default
state 'proof-only', rule 'proof first; no promotion without foldback evidence'
neutral organ fallback: glyph 'arc', idle state
feeds branch state text; Inspect link shows 'source packet missing'
feeds stale detection via state text scan
source defaults 'product-branch-packets@v1'; staleDetail from envelope freshness
single KpiPulse row 'KPI missing / not proven / survival threshold missing'

dataFields.source: branchStories.rows[] proof requirement rows (normalized by mcProofNeeded)
dataFields.fallback: ProofList row 'Proof requirement missing' in proof-needed alias state
0; summary shows branch arc count instead of quest count
treated as stale; stale notice renders
staleness derived from derivedAt age > 360 min

aliases.proof-needed: dashed hollow ring treatment (frozen/02 STATE STACK 'Proof needed' row); maps through mcStateKind

derivation.selected: focused branch chip (MISSION_BRANCH_FOCUS or ?branch=) — SelectedHalo on branch-chip
derivation.active: branch/mission with unverified current gate — chartreuse arc + packet dots
derivation.complete: questline stage or gate with status verified/complete/done
derivation.blocked: gate status blocked/warning/gap/missing, or mission-gap fallback — full peach re-tint
derivation.locked: questline stage past active node, or ts-style locked status — dim padlock
derivation.stale: branch/envelope freshness stale or derivedAt older than 360 min — desaturated + stale notice
derivation.idle: neutral organ fallback or branch with no state signal

loading.render: 'Synchronizing branch packets / Please wait…' + linear progress bar

empty.render: dashed circle + node icon; 'Mission control is waiting for branch packets.' + Refresh (outline) + Inspect (outline)

error.render: peach triangle; 'ledger unreachable — pull down to retry' + Retry outline button; no local write
